Since $x,$ $y,$ and $z$ lie on a circle in the complex coordinates, and all the distances from the center of this circle to these points equal this same circle radius $r,$ a valid polynomial is

$(z-r)(z-(a+bi))(z-(a-bi)) = z^3 - (2r+a-bi-a+bi)z^2 + (r^2+2ar^2+2(a^2+b^2)r)+(a^2+b^2-r^2) = z^3 + sz+t.$

Thus $s = -(2r+a-bi-a+bi) = -(4r-2a+i(b-a)-i(a+b))=-4r+2a+i(2b-a-i(a+b)) = -2(2r+bi)-(2a+bi)+(a+b);$ $(-2a-b)(-2a-b)^2 = -(2x+2y)(2x+2y)^2+r^2-4r^2,$ where $x = 2a+bi, y=a+bi.$ Thus $(-(4r-a-bi)-(2a+bi))^2 = -(4r-a-bi)(2a+bi)-a(2a+bi)-b(2a+bi)-b^2,$ which is also $(-2(2r+bi)-(2a+bi))(-2(2r+bi)-2a-bi)^2 = (2r+bi-(2a+bi))(2r+bi-2a-bi),$ which is $2(2r-bi)(2a+bi)(2r-a-bi)(2a+bi),$ so $2b(2r-bi)(2a+bi)(2r-a-bi)(2a+bi) = 0,$ so $a+b = 2r;$ $c^2 = -(2r+a-bi-a+bi) = -4r+2a+i(2b-a-i(a+b)) = -4r+2r+i(4r-2a)$ $=(4r-2a)(1+i),$ so $|c|^2 = 4r^2+4r(2a-b)+(2a-b)^2;$ $2a+b = 2r+2b.$ Since $((2a+b)i)^2 = -(4a+2bi),$ and $b^2 = (2a+b)^2,$ and $c = (2a+b)+bi,$  $0 = (2r+2b)(2r-b)-(2a+b)^2-2bi(2a+b),$

so $0 = b^2+(2r-b)^2-2bi(2a+b),$ so $2bi(2a+b) = (2r-b)^2+b^2 = 4r^2-4rb+b^2+4r^2-2rb+b^2 = 8r^2-6rb+2b^2,$ so $2bi(2a+b) = 2(4r^2-3rb+b^2);$ $2bi(2a+b) = 2((2r-b)^2+b^2);$ si  $2bi(2a+b) = 2((2a+b)(2r-b)+b^2);$ If $2bi(2a+b) = 0,$ then $2bi = 0,$ a contradiction. So $2a+b \neq 0.$ Thus $\frac{2bi}{2a+b} = \frac{2(4r^2-3rb+b^2)}{2(4r^2-3rb+b^2)} = 1.$ Thus $b(2a+b) = \frac{2bi}{2} = bi = b^2; \frac{b}{2} = bi \implies \frac{b}{2} = \frac{b^2}{i}.$ Thus $0 = \frac{b^4-b^2}{i}.$ Thus $b^2 = 0.$ Thus $4r(2a-b)^2 + 2(2a+b)(b^2)= (4r-a-bi)(2a+bi) = 4r(a-b) + -bi(4r-a-bi)) = 4ar-4rb-i(4r^2-cb^2),$ so $4r(2a-b)^2 + (2a+b)(b^2) = -4r^2+4ra,$ or $4r^2-cb^2 = 4r^2-4rb+b^2.$ Thus $-cb^2 = -4rb + b^2.$ Thus $b^2 = 4rb+c(2a+b) = 4rb+c(2rb);$ $b^2 = 4rb+c(2rb);$ $b^2= 4r+b(2k+4b);$ $b^2 = a(4r-b)-bc+2nd^2+e^2.$ Since $4r-2a = i(2b-a),$ then $-b = i(2a-b);$ $b = -i(2a-b);$ $b-bi = -2ai; ;;$ $b(1-ib) = -2ai;$ $b = \frac{-2ai}{1-ib};$
